question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
WITH striker_match_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker,
        bb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_totals
    WHERE total_runs > 50
),
striker_grand_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        smt.striker,
        SUM(smt.total_runs) AS grand_total
    FROM striker_match_totals smt
    JOIN qualifying_strikers qs ON smt.striker = qs.striker
    GROUP BY smt.striker
)
SELECT AVG(grand_total) AS average_of_total_runs
FROM striker_grand_totals
